qa_pairs.question: What special tools are needed to pull the input shaft, output shaft and layshaft into the case rear section?
qa_pairs.answer: Special Tools 23 1 300 and 23 2 150 are needed to pull the input shaft, output shaft and layshaft into the case rear section.

qa_pairs.question: What are the 10 components shown in the arrest assembly diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: The components are: 1-End cap, 2-Spring, 3-Locking ball, 4-Detent ball, 5-Lockpin, 6-Selector arm, 7-Lockpin, 8-Spring, 9-Locking lever, 10-Spring.

qa_pairs.question: What should be done to the selector rods before sliding the 3rd/4th gear selector rod through the selector forks?
qa_pairs.answer: Move selector rods to neutral position before sliding the 3rd/4th gear selector rod through the selector forks.

qa_pairs.question: How should the lockpin be installed in the selector rod?
qa_pairs.answer: Install lockpin (1) in selector rod with grease, push in selector rod up to bore, with opening in selector rod faces up.

qa_pairs.question: What size pin should be driven into the 3rd/4th gear selector fork?
qa_pairs.answer: Drive a 6 x 26 mm pin into the 3rd/4th gear selector fork (counterhold).

qa_pairs.question: How should the detent balls be installed?
qa_pairs.answer: Install two detent balls with grease, push in 3rd/4th gear selector rod against lock.

qa_pairs.question: What components need to be inserted for the version with different length springs?
qa_pairs.answer: Insert three locking balls and three springs. For the version with different length springs, install short spring (1) with a relaxed length (A) of 15.9 mm to face 5th/reverse gear selector rod.

qa_pairs.question: What gears are engaged when heating the ball bearing inner race?
qa_pairs.answer: Second and reverse gears are engaged when heating the ball bearing inner race.

qa_pairs.question: What should be done after inserting the input shaft, output shaft and layshaft?
qa_pairs.answer: Align selector rods after inserting the input shaft, output shaft and layshaft in the case rear section.

qa_pairs.question: What is the relaxed length specification for the short spring in versions with different length springs?
qa_pairs.answer: The short spring (1) has a relaxed length (A) of 15.9 mm (0.626 inches).
